_about: 观里的事 (rules/happenings.mjs, worlds/jiuding/happenings.json, Hanli 2026-11-10 「可以，按这个做」): the boards a happening deals that no place hosted before — hosted, practice, paid by their minutes as every board (rules/playpay.mjs; no grant of their own). Rows only.

tasks._why: 讲堂早课 (happenings.json jiangtang-zaoke): 古六's 讲堂试法 again at the 讲堂 — the same throws (砸寨 `jiangtang`), and where a camera is, the 结印 lesson as its other way, with its no-camera demo (qianye-qiajue's `alt`, Hanli 11-10: 「如果用户不开摄像头, 就改成自动演示给用户demo结印」). The fuller 师父传印 (seal book, mastery, weekly exam) is a later task. Practice: no marks.
tasks._varies: one level of a skill kit, played again with the hands (happenings.json `again`, rules/happenings.mjs repeatable): in the 观里的事 it is dealt again; won, the 小游戏池 would rest it.

alt._demo: 2026-11-10 (Hanli: 「结印课堂…是很重要的课堂. 如果用户不开摄像头, 就改成自动演示给用户demo结印」): dealt on every device, the phone too. No camera, or the camera refused or failing: the level plays the lesson by itself (levels/jieyin.json `auto`), then leaves `unable` and 讲堂试法 is dealt — he still plays the beat and is paid by it.

title.en: The lecture hall · One seal at a time

how.zh: 对着摄像头，照褚先生说的，一个印一个印地结，每个稳住一下才算；结错了，再来。五个都会了，四个连起来，午文收尾，火蛋打讲堂后头的草人。
how.en: At the camera, make the seals one by one as Master Chu says, each held a moment; a wrong one, try again. All five learned, make four in a row ending on Wu, and the fire egg hits the straw dummy at the back of the hall.

title.en: The lecture hall · Trying the spells

how.zh: 往后拉，松手，把法术扔向讲堂后头的草人。火弹落地就炸；冰锥飞行中点一下，一分为三；金刃点一下，直冲出去，木头一刀两断。扔一回，丹田便空一截——四回。
how.en: Pull back and let go: throw the spells at the straw dummies at the back of the hall. The fireball bursts where it lands; tap the ice spike in flight and it splits in three; tap the gold blade and it shoots straight, cutting wood clean through. Each throw empties the dantian a notch: four throws.

done_line.zh: 草人倒了一排，褚先生的戒尺在桌上敲了一下。
done_line.en: A row of straw dummies down; Master Chu taps his ruler once on the desk.

tasks._why: 巡山送信 (happenings.json shanmen-songxin): a letter up from the 山门 to the 执事堂 against a stick of incense — 几何冲刺 on 第三回's 三百级 (games.json dash `sanbai-dash`, its own row for this task).
tasks._varies: one level of a skill kit, played again with the hands (happenings.json `again`, rules/happenings.mjs repeatable): in the 观里的事 it is dealt again; won, the 小游戏池 would rest it.

title.en: The letter · One stick of incense

how.zh: 一炷香里把信送上去：一级一级跳上去，按住连跳。碰上了，从头。
how.en: Get the letter up within one stick of incense: jump the steps one by one, hold to keep jumping. Touch one, start over.

done_line.en: The letter is in; a stub of incense still burns.

tasks._why: 妖兽出没 as a wave (rules/forms.mjs, happenings.json `forms.yaoshou`): the batch's beast, when its kind is one 守墙关 knows, comes some batches as a night of its own kind at the wall — the 兽潮's tide maker with that kind alone. Not hosted: open only while the batch's fight is a wave where he stands; its win settles as the duel's (tasks.mjs yaoshouWaveDone). No art of its own: 守墙关's.

how.zh: 它们成群下山了：点空位布防，守住墙头，一只也别放进来。
how.en: They come down in a pack: tap an empty spot to set a guard and hold the wall; let none through.

done_line.zh: 山道上安静了，墙头一块砖没少。
done_line.en: The path is quiet; not a brick gone from the wall.

tasks._why: 师父传印 (chuanyin.json; Hanli 2026-11-10: 「可以，按这个做」): the weekly lesson, dealt by 讲堂早课 only when the week is out and a seal whose spell he has met is not yet taught (`needs: seals.lesson`, the deal puts it `first`). Pays three small games' worth (`own.games`, the unit form of 传音's), instead of its own minutes. Camera or, with none, tapping the figures — the same pay; mastery at half.
tasks._varies: A lesson or a drill of the master's, played again with the hands (happenings.json `again` names jieyin, rules/happenings.mjs repeatable).

title.en: The master passes on a seal

how.zh: 褚先生每周传一个印：先看他结一遍，再跟着结，最后限时考。没有摄像头也行，点一点手势就是。过了，记进印谱。
how.en: Master Chu passes on one seal a week: watch him make it, follow him, then the timed test. No camera needed — tap the gestures instead. Passed, it goes into the seal book.

done_line.zh: 褚先生点了点头，戒尺在桌上敲了一下：「记下了。」
done_line.en: Master Chu nods and taps the ruler once on the desk: "Noted."

tasks._why: 师父传印's daily drill: two or three learned seals chained (rules/seals.mjs drillRows), dealt only with two learned (`needs: seals.drill`). Pays one small game's worth (`own.games`).
tasks._varies: A lesson or a drill of the master's, played again with the hands (happenings.json `again` names jieyin, rules/happenings.mjs repeatable).

title.en: The lecture hall · Seals in a chain

how.zh: 褚先生点两三个学过的印，叫你连着结：摄像头前一个接一个，没有摄像头就按次序点手势。
how.en: Master Chu names two or three seals you have learned and has you chain them: one after another at the camera, or, with none, tapped in order.

done_line.zh: 褚先生看了一遍，没说好，也没说不好，只把戒尺放下了。
done_line.en: Master Chu watches the whole chain, says neither good nor bad, and only sets the ruler down.

tasks._why: The chain errand 九节菖蒲's lesson step (quests/guan.json guan-jiujie-4a): the board an errand asks for at the 讲堂, never dealt by the draw (`needs: seals.step` is never true). The page asks the rules for its plan with intent 'step' (chuanyin.json `step.seals`: a seal he lacks is taught, else a drill).
tasks._varies: A lesson or a drill of the master's, played again with the hands (happenings.json `again` names jieyin, rules/happenings.mjs repeatable).

title.en: The master's seal · Before the furnace

how.zh: 褚先生把看炉要用的印过一遍：没学的现教，学过的连着结。
how.en: Master Chu goes over the seals the furnace watch will use: one you lack is taught, the ones you know are chained.

done_line.zh: 褚先生把戒尺往肩上一搭：「去吧，炉子不等人。」
done_line.en: Master Chu rests the ruler on his shoulder: "Go on; the furnace waits for no one."
